title: Halo Halo German Dessert
description: A modern twist on the classic Filipino dessert, incorporating traditional German flavors.

ingredients.name: Energizing Matcha Ice Cream
ingredients.notes: or substitute with German-style vanilla ice cream

ingredients.name: Freekeh Crisps
ingredients.notes: crushed freekeh cereal, fried until crispy

ingredients.name: Whipped Cream
ingredients.notes: heavy cream whipped until stiff peaks form

ingredients.name: Halo Halo Sauce (Filipino-style)
ingredients.notes: sweetened condensed milk, mixed with evaporated milk

ingredients.name: German Chocolate Shavings
ingredients.notes: optional, for added flavor and texture

instructions: Combine yellow corn and halo halo toppings in a large bowl.
Scoop energizing matcha ice cream on top of the corn mixture.
Sprinkle freekeh crisps and whipped cream over the ice cream.
Drizzle halo halo sauce over the top of the dessert.
Garnish with German chocolate shavings, if desired.
